request.input: list of {type: image, data: base64, mime_type} followed by {type: text, text}

response_format.delivery: uri for outputs larger than 4 MB

request.background: the guide recommends false for synchronous unary generation
request.store: false means the result cannot be edited or extended in a later turn

output.location: steps[] model_output with type video, mime_type video/mp4, data (base64) or uri
output.uri_retrieval: GET /v1beta/files/{id} until state ACTIVE (FAILED is final), then GET /v1beta/files/{id}:download?alt=media

documented.multi_shot: the model may cut between shots; timing can be written in the prompt as [0-3s] ...
documented.audio: generated with the video by default and steered through the prompt
documented.duration_field: not documented on the pages read; third-party gateways list 3 to 10 seconds with differing defaults, so it is unverified here

pricing.basis: $17.50 per 1M output tokens at 5,792 tokens per second of 720p video
pricing.1080p_status: unverified: the pricing page states no 1080p rate
